The organ features a symmetrical facade with three main sections of vertical metal pipes: a central cluster of shorter, darker pipes flanked by two taller sections of silver-colored pipes with gold accents at the top. The instrument is housed in a white and gold decorative case with carved moldings, set against cream-colored walls with Corinthian-style pilasters and an arched ceiling.
